items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When Von Gatwood... Could you tell me? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Yeah. Well, it was a little club. Oh, yeah. Well, that was Tony Denapolis' place. Yeah.

ctx.x: You ought to see that. Not Hazel. I was in there. I got a key from him over there. No, no, no, no. He had 700 keys there. If the red light was on, don't come in. If the red light was on. He'll come back later. Well, I think Tony had left the Liberty then.
When Von Gatwood... Could you tell me? Yeah.
